name: ProService Building Services Marketplace Plc
summary: ProService Building Services Marketplace Plc, operating with its various subsidiaries, specializes in providing equipment and tool rental services, along with associated support, throughout the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland. Its operations are channeled through two distinct divisions: HSS ProService and HSS The Hire Service Company. The firm also provides 'Brenda,' a specialized digital platform designed to fuel its future marketplace expansion. Additionally, it delivers various training courses to clients. Known as HSS Hire Group plc until November 2025, the company officially adopted its current name, ProService Building Services Marketplace Plc, at that time. ProService Building Services Marketplace Plc was established in 1957 and maintains its primary corporate office in Manchester, United Kingdom.
